reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis assumes L1₀ ordering in an equiatomic FeCoNiMnCu alloy, but this system is a well-known single-phase FCC high-entropy alloy with no thermodynamic driving force for such ordering, making the proposed mechanism physically unsound.
reasons.testability: The test is clearly described with specific measurements (XRD, TEM, magnetometry) and a quantitative falsification criterion (>10x coercivity increase and L1₀ signatures), making it decisive.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a mechanism (L1₀ ordering) that is fundamentally incompatible with the chosen alloy system, so testing it would be a waste of resources.
